items.question: How should RAKL discover missing facets before search without hallucinating an unbounded ontology?
items.incumbent: fixed perspective axes + LLM candidate generation + semantic dedup
items.next_discriminator: RAKLBench corpus where known hidden facets must be recovered with controlled false-facet rate

items.question: When can contextual local views be glued into one global portrait, and when should RAKL retain a plural/obstructed atlas?
items.incumbent: typed relations + context + conceptual transition maps
items.next_discriminator: known-answer multi-view worlds with exact gluing, context-dependent gluing, and impossible gluing

items.question: How should RAKL explore hypothesis/method branches without premature greedy collapse or combinatorial explosion?
items.incumbent: versioned research tree + Pareto frontier + mechanism-family diversity
items.next_discriminator: long-horizon benchmark with deceptive local optimum and true alternative branch

items.question: How should resources be allocated among exploit/diversify/moonshot/meta research as novelty and residuals change?
items.next_discriminator: simulation of research landscapes with changing novelty/cost profiles

items.question: Which LLM-dependent RAKL steps should be declarative modules and how can prompts/programs be optimized without benchmark gaming?
items.next_discriminator: frozen atomic benchmark comparing hand-authored and optimized modules under contamination controls

items.question: How should RAKL choose the next paper query, measurement or experiment to maximally reduce decision-relevant uncertainty?
items.incumbent: separation + identified-set shrinkage per cost heuristic
items.next_discriminator: known hypothesis worlds where high-volume search is inferior to one targeted query

items.question: How can RAKL evaluate atomic and long-horizon scientific-research abilities without training on the confirmation benchmark?
items.next_discriminator: implement executable known-answer fixtures and meta-train/read-once split registry

items.question: How should cross-session research memory preserve failures, provenance and supersession while remaining retrievable and context-efficient?
items.next_discriminator: long-horizon benchmark that attempts to resurrect superseded/refuted ideas and create conflicting successors

items.question: How should RAKL expose sensitivity to reasonable atomic choices without brute-force explosion?
items.next_discriminator: known workflow where one atomic decision drives conclusion and many irrelevant forks do not

items.question: When should RAKL revise non-constitutional meta-objectives or benchmark metrics?
items.incumbent: fixed blocking constitution + mutable optimization meta-QoIs
items.next_discriminator: benchmark where original proxy improves while true research quality degrades

items.question: When has each atomic knowledge fiber stopped yielding new retained meaning across genuinely distinct discovery routes?
items.incumbent: route coverage + same-context/independent flat rounds + diagnostic unseen-mass estimates
items.next_discriminator: simulated semantic universes with known unseen objects and route-dependent sampling

items.question: How should RAKL reason when literature is saturated but a problem is unidentifiable/blocked, or when a QoI is solved before knowledge is saturated?
items.incumbent: two independent states: knowledge_saturation and problem_closure
items.next_discriminator: known-answer cases covering all four combinations of saturated/not-saturated × closed/not-closed

items.question: How should RAKL select and compose workflow modules with minimal context while avoiding missed required procedures?
items.next_discriminator: ambiguous/adversarial routing corpus with token-cost and missed-module metrics

items.question: How should RAKL obtain diverse critical review without fake independence or duplicated narratives?
items.incumbent: same immutable packet + isolated blind reviewers + frozen reports + separate synthesis
items.next_discriminator: planted-flaw corpus comparing same-context reflection vs genuinely isolated review

instruction: Hourly self-R&D should update statuses, add new child fibers when residuals demand them, and never mark the global method saturated while a priority fiber is NON_FLAT or required independent rounds are missing.
